title: postbiotic-lta-audit: what the sequence record can and cannot say about lipoteichoic acid D-alanylation
description: Code, calling criteria and data for the manuscript 'Lipoteichoic acid as a test case for what the genome cannot specify in postbiotics'. Screens 9,143 deposited RefSeq assemblies for the capacity to remove D-alanine from lipoteichoic acid, resolving gene presence, predicted localization and substrate-contact conservation; audits the public annotation of that enzyme; and tests measured substitution values against the resulting classification. No new sequence and no new laboratory measurement were generated. Calling criteria are held outside the code and the pre-registration record states when each was fixed. Version 1.2.0 is a complete re-run of the pipeline on 2026-09-23: every call reproduced, supplementary tables renumbered consecutively, and the threshold-sensitivity figures corrected to 27.1% and 48.7%.
